patch.value:
Deepen pm-jira to domain-appropriate maximum against SDK 2026.5.31.

VALUE: pm-jira already had jira sync/import/export + schema fields + status-map (commit dbf38cf). This feature closes the remaining real gaps from the enhancement brief.

OUTCOME: idempotent re-import (update existing pm items matched on Jira key instead of duplicating; persist jira_key/jira_url), a real credential+reachability preflight surfaced as the 'preflight' capability, rate-limit/backoff robustness, and an --assignee filter. Manifest capabilities corrected to match what is actually registered (drop unregistered 'services' filler; add 'preflight').

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- pm jira import re-run updates matched items (no duplicates), keyed on Jira key provenance + jira_key field.
- jira_key/jira_url persisted onto items (via pm update --field or description marker fallback).
- pm jira preflight validates creds + base URL + reachability with clear failure_hints; registerPreflight guard registered.
- 429/503 responses retried with exponential backoff + Retry-After honoring.
- --assignee filter augments default JQL.
- manifest capabilities == registered surfaces exactly.
- typecheck/build/test/changelog:check/release:check all green; new unit tests for idempotency match + backoff parse + preflight.
- Functionally tested in --dry-run against scratch workspace with fixture JSON.
pm-jira: domain-max SDK enhancement (idempotent import, preflight, rate-limit backoff)
